purpose: Pre-register a blinded human audit of endpoint observability only.

amendment.scope: Operational reviewer codebook and package presentation contract only.
amendment.technical_note_column: removed; the return schema is exactly five columns

source_authority.population_reuse: Exact AC4 neutral presentation population; no replacement, top-up, rerender, new video, or new state.

reviewers.identity_policy: Use reviewer IDs only; do not commit real names, contact details, signatures, or personal information.
reviewers.independence: Each reviewer works from a separate package and must not see another review, AI labels, automatic labels, telemetry, model, suite, parent, condition, dose, outcomes, or hidden mapping.

frozen_population.present_clip_rule: One label for each of the 91 present clips; fixed missing slots are not replaced and are not labelable.

observability_gate.ambiguous: Some relevant evidence is visible but uncertainty remains due to occlusion, blur, conflicting cues, or normal-placement ambiguity.
observability_gate.not_identifiable: The evidence needed to identify the object/gripper relationship or event is essentially unavailable.

reviewer_note.reason: V2 has no technical-note column; free text could introduce hidden metadata or outcome claims.

analysis_plan_after_all_three_seals.phase_a: Validate exactly 91 rows per reviewer, legal labels, no duplicate or missing local IDs, correct order, package digests, mapping seal, and reviewer identity; seal returned files before unblinding.

binary_observability.interpretation: Observability/adjudicability only; not physical failure, success, robustness, or endpoint confirmation.
